description: This file contains test cases for the 'provider-models' module, using the Vitest testing framework. It tests functions related to Ollama API interactions, including resolving API base URLs and enriching model data with context window information.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Sets up cleanup after each test case, un-stubbing all global mocks.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for Ollama provider models.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertion function used to verify test outcomes.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for specific functionalities.

methods.name: vi.fn
methods.description: Creates a mock function for spying or stubbing.

methods.name: vi.unstubAllGlobals
methods.description: Removes all global mocks/stubs set during tests.

methods.name: vi.stubGlobal
methods.description: Stubs a global variable or function, e.g., fetch.

methods.name: resolveOllamaApiBase
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for the Ollama API, stripping '/v1' suffix if present.

methods.name: enrichOllamaModelsWithContext
methods.description: Fetches additional model info to enrich model objects with context window data.

ctags.name: body
ctags.pattern: /^      const body = JSON.parse(requestBodyText(init?.body)) as { name?: string };$/

ctags.name: fetchMock
ctags.pattern: /^    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => {$/
